name: hud_shield_message_widget_apply_layout
description: HudUiShieldMessageWidget::ApplyLayout wires the shield message image, percent label, meter quad, clipping, and HUD child registration from a layout root.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD shield-message/source-cluster tier S pass.

The native smoke keeps image lookup inert and verifies the downstream layout wiring against a preinstalled widget image; HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyImageWidget has separate functional evidence for image-path and preloaded-image behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40eb00 validates applying layoutRoot[1] to the shield widget with HUD origins, reading widget center X/Y for offsetXY, applying layoutRoot[2] to the percent text panel, clipping the percent panel to panel GetX/GetY minus offsetXY, setting percent text to "000", updating text bounds, applying layoutRoot[3] to the meter quad, clipping the meter to the widget image, and adding widget, panel, and meter to g_HudUiMgr in that order.

The native smoke verifies offset propagation from widget center slots, percent-panel SetPos and SetTextFmt calls, panel clipping to the widget image, the forced "000" text update, bounds refresh dispatch, meter quad geometry and clip rect, and HudUiMgr child order/parent links.
